destination_based_cargo_grouping.description: Cargo should be grouped by destination wherever physically and operationally practical.

anti_fragmentation_cargo_loading.description: Avoid unnecessary fragmentation across panels, grids, or unloading sequences.

anti_mixing_destination_rules.description: Avoid placing visually similar cargo for different destinations adjacent to each other when it can create unloading errors.

unload_first_sequencing.description: Cargo for the next drop should remain easiest to identify and unload.

panel_readability_preservation.description: Cargo panel assignments should remain human-readable by destination and purpose.

unloading_cognitive_load_minimization.description: Operational plans should reduce sorting burden at the destination.

operational_recovery_handling.description: Routes should include practical recovery options when dead-leg or congestion risk is high.

practical_route_sustainability.description: Prefer route plans that remain executable under fatigue, server instability, and imperfect OCR.

preservation_rules: These doctrine rules do not replace sourced game facts.
Unknown cargo mechanics must remain unresolved.
Mission details must never be invented.
